$comment: The widget's shared parts (checked by ci/reuse.mjs). Something new (a module, an animation) is listed here on purpose, with what it is, in the same pull request, so it's a choice made in review and not a copy that slipped in. Before adding one, look for the part that already does it.

modules.anchoring.ts: where a pin sits on the page and how it finds its spot again
modules.boardcam.ts: a board in the page: showing it, a tap on it that closes a comment, its camera moving the pins with it, and the page's pins hiding under its view
modules.sheetmove.ts: how a drawer moves under a finger and after it lets go (glide, carry, the throw that closes it): the comment drawers (sheets.ts) and the board drawer (src/board/overlay.ts) share it
modules.lifttap.ts: phones: which touches are taps that act on the finger's lift (a pin, the dimmed page under a sheet) instead of on the click iOS may hold back: the slop and time a tap may take (comments.js; sheets.ts reads the slop)
modules.components.ts: which component drew an element (React, Vue, Svelte), for a pin; its own file (public/_lab/components.js), loaded only on a page a framework drew
modules.composer.ts: the text box for a comment or a reply, and its send button
modules.framework.ts: whether the page was drawn by React, Vue or Svelte, so components.ts is loaded and can say which component a pin is on
modules.frame.ts: a page inside a board's frame: draws nothing, binds nothing; keeps live updates and passes keys to the board
modules.hold.ts: a dev server's reload waits while a sheet is open
modules.pinhold.ts: pins the browser holds on their element with CSS anchor positioning (flag native): no script on scroll
modules.ink.ts: drawing pins (hold D and drag): the lines as they are drawn and over a saved drawing, and the drawing as an area comment
modules.drag.ts: dragging to mark an area (or, holding D, a drawing) with a mouse or pen, the ink at the end of a drag, and the words selected with Shift + drag offered as a comment
modules.draw.ts: what a drawing's lines read as (circled, arrow, underlined…); its own file (public/_lab/draw.js), loaded when D is first pressed
modules.keys.ts: the Shift and Alt keys: Shift (drag to quote words) with its cursor and Alt (Option) with its crosshair
modules.list.ts: the list of pins (a sheet on phones)
modules.live.ts: the live stream: listening badge, mode, who is heard
modules.messages.ts: one message in a thread or the chat
modules.motion.ts: pause and speed (¼ ½ 1) for what moves on the page (videos, animations) from a right-click menu on a computer and ⋯ → motion on a phone, and a pin's moment on it; its own file (public/_lab/motion.js), loaded once the page has something that moves, P or S is pressed, or a comment has a moment
modules.motion.css: the styles of motion.ts, which brings them with it
modules.actions.ts: action buttons: a data-lab-action element on the page opens a comment with its words, the agent acts on it
modules.attach.ts: the pictures of a comment: the strip above a box that holds some (paste, drop, ✕), the send with their tokens, and a message's thumbnails; its own file (public/_lab/attach.js), loaded when a picture comes or a message has one
modules.reload.ts: live reload in place: a saved stylesheet, picture, font or the page's own HTML patched without a reload (scroll, open things and typed text stay); its own file (public/_lab/reload.js), loaded by live.ts on the first save the page hears about
modules.attach.css: the styles of attach.ts, which brings them with it
modules.pics.ts: a picture made ready to send (the board's paste and a comment's attachment): kept as it is when small, else drawn smaller and encoded again; its own file (public/_lab/pics.js), loaded the first time a picture is put in
modules.sheets.ts: THE drawer: every sheet on a phone (handle, swipe down, dimmed page, keyboard fit, back closes). Any new panel on a phone uses it.
modules.stick.ts: a message list that stays at its newest while it shrinks (keyboard up) until you scroll back; used by the chat and a thread
modules.switcher.ts: labs & pages (⌘K): a box on a computer, one of the sheets on a phone; built as its own file (public/_lab/switcher.js), loaded on the first ⌘K or ⋯ open
modules.switcher.css: the styles of switcher.ts, which brings them with it
modules.trial.ts: a question's choices tried in the sentence: which row is tried, kept over a redraw and put back; the swap itself is tryout.ts
modules.tryout.ts: the swap of trial.ts: the differing words swapped in place, the block's height held, the page put back exactly; its own file (public/_lab/tryout.js), loaded as a card with rows to try in place is drawn
modules.goto.ts: a block named in a message (#id): scrolled into view and marked for a moment; its own file (public/_lab/goto.js), loaded on the first such link followed
modules.walkie.ts: Walkie-talkie: talk while you point, with the computer's own dictation (no microphone); the pointer, clicks, circles, shakes and selected words are matched to the words and sent to the chat as one message; its own file (public/_lab/walkie.js), loaded on the bar's walkie-talkie or K
modules.walkie.css: the styles of walkie.ts, which brings them with it

classes.pinboard: the host of a board pin's strip in its card (boardcam.ts); the board's part draws the strip inside it, so no rule of the widget's styles it
classes.copy-all: the copy-link button: a row of the ⋯ menu (its rules), or hidden in the corner when comments are off; comments.js looks it up
classes.walkie-btn: the bar's walkie-talkie part (comments.js looks it up, walkie.ts takes over); a bar segment like the others, no rule of its own
classes.boards-btn: the page's "boards · N" part of the bar (comments.js looks it up, list.ts fills it); a bar segment like the others, no rule of its own
classes.pv: a board picture's preview, over the picture (mount.ts sets its src and shows it); styled by the board's img rules
classes.moved-btn: the 'moved' button in the bar; comments.js looks it up and the browser tests click it
classes.nm: the name box in the first-comment form; the tests fill it
classes.ini: the pointer's inner mark; comments.js sets its text and the tests read it
classes.item: a message in a thread card; thread.ts looks the messages up
classes.under: a card set under its words (trial.ts); comments.js asks whether a card is one when it ties it to its pin
classes.cur: the labs & pages row you are on (switcher.ts): arrow keys start from it
classes.bv-close: the board view's close button; the board browser tests click it
classes.saved: a stored area's outline (anchoring.ts drawZone 'saved', as against a new one's 'draft'): boardcam.ts finds it to move it with the board's camera; no rule of its own

$where: Files that may own a part: the drawer's gestures and keyboard fit live in sheets.ts (comments.js wires them up).

values.$comment: Values written into a rule on purpose (ci/reuse.mjs part 6). Everything else comes from a token. Add one here with why, in the pull request that needs it.

radii.14px 14px 14px 2px: the pin: a teardrop, its tail at the bottom left (28 px)
radii.11px 11px 11px 2px: the pin glyph in the bar: the same teardrop at 22 px
radii.18px 18px 18px 6px: the ring around a pin: the teardrop 4 px out, concentric
radii.2px: the grab handle: a 4 px tall pill
radii.8px: the switch in the ⋯ menu: a 16 px tall pill
radii.12px: the switch knob: a 12 px circle

motion.0ms !important: reduced motion: every animation runs at once

code.anchoring.ts: rgb(1, 2, 3): a sentinel colour to tell whether the page set one, never drawn
code.sheetmove.ts: cubic-bezier(: a sheet let go carries on at the speed it had: the curve is worked out from that speed and the way left (docs/motion.md), so no token can hold it
code.comments.js: rgba(52, 199, 89, .3): the selection highlight, drawn in the page document where the widget tokens are not
